ideas.title: Wool on the sail: trim the land yacht by its telltales
ideas.goal: The player sails the bare cart along the beach and trims the sheet by eye: red wool threads near the sail's front edge stream flat when it is right, the windward ones stand off and droop when it is too loose, the lee ones lift and twitch when it is too tight. Getting the most speed out of a gust is a skill you feel in your hands, with no gauge.
ideas.toward: Land yacht step of the road: the cart moving by the flow around its own sail, the sail box riding with the cart.
ideas.idea: s164 measured it: in the solved 3D flow around the tall cambered sail the windward luff yarn stands off 25-60 deg at 0-2.5 deg (luffing), both lie down at 5-10, the lee one lifts 14/28/40 deg at 20/30/40 and the flow under it reverses, then goes unsteady (stall). Each yarn becomes a short rod with drag from the sampled velocity squared plus gravity, so it hangs limp in the slow bubble and streams in fast air. The WaterLily box (32 cells per chord) rides with the cart on the GPU, re-solved as the apparent wind turns; the cart on its board wheels moves by the sail's force minus rolling resistance in the sand.
ideas.form: A plugin on the beach: the cart with a sailcloth asset on a driftwood mast, keys to sheet in and out in Jump in; a traced film close on the luff, the wool going from drooping to streaming as Lumi pulls the sheet and the cart starts to roll.

ideas.title: Hike out: the friends' weight keeps the yacht on its wheels
ideas.goal: In a gust the land yacht heels and lifts its windward wheel; the player calls friends to the windward rail and their real weight holds it down. Too few friends and it tips; too many and it is slow in the soft sand. Choosing the crew for today's wind is the game.
ideas.toward: Friends ride the cart (the big goal's last step), creatures with real masses (#745), the sail force from the flow.
ideas.idea: Heeling moment = the solved sail force times the height of its centre; righting moment = each friend's mass (mesh volume times density, pony-sized) times their lever arm across the track. The cart is a rigid body on PrintSim contacts; a wheel lifts when heel wins. The friends walk across the deck to where they are called; a body that slips off when it tips really falls into the sand.
ideas.form: Plugin on the beach with the yacht; a film of a gust lifting a wheel, Pickles and Truffle scrambling to the high side, the wheel thumping down.

ideas.title: The axle dynamo against the wind
ideas.goal: The player clutches the dynamo onto the yacht's axle while sailing: the clay pots fill, but the cart slows by exactly the power it takes. Charge on the downwind run, unclutch for the climb: a choice every run.
ideas.toward: Dynamo on the land yacht's axle charging the pots (road: motor run backwards, storage).
ideas.idea: The drum motor (physics/motor.jl) run backwards: its back-EMF from the axle speed drives a current through the circuit solver into the clay-pot cells; the torque that current makes brakes the axle. Nothing set by hand: speed, current, charge and drag come from the same equations.
ideas.form: Plugin part on the yacht; a traced film close on the commutator sparking as the cart rolls downwind and slows when the clutch bites.

ideas.title: Sail cloth that luffs for real
ideas.goal: The sail is cloth, not a plate: let the sheet out and its front edge really shivers and flaps; pull in and it fills into a hard curve with a crack. The player hears and sees the trim.
ideas.toward: The land yacht's sail, real materials (canvas), fluid and structure together.
ideas.idea: A PrintSim cloth sheet (todo #611's contact fix first) pinned to mast and boom; its shape each step is the body in the WaterLily box (sdf from the cloth triangles), the pressure on each cell pushes the cloth back. Luffing becomes flutter of a membrane, a known two-way coupled instability, no animation.
ideas.form: An engine change in sailflow + PrintSim, shown on the yacht in a close traced film of the luff shaking then filling.

ideas.title: Plank fences in Jump in: the dune drifts while you watch
ideas.goal: The player carries planks and plants them as fences on the dune; within minutes a drift of sand grows in front of a solid fence or behind a slatted one, and the player shapes the ramp the cart will climb.
ideas.toward: Sand fences project: the cart's ramp from the wind, the plank road.
ideas.idea: physics/groundwind.jl's solved flow over each fence (re-solved on a background thread when a fence moves) feeds Kawamura saltation into physics/sandfield.jl on a 12 x 6 m dune patch; the sand slumps to repose; planks use the driftwood asset.
ideas.form: A dune plugin with plank pick up/plant in Jump in; a time-lapse traced film of the drift building behind a fence at dusk.

ideas.title: Lumi's crest is a wind vane
ideas.goal: Lumi's head feathers and tail stream in the real wind wherever Lumi stands, so the player reads the wind off Lumi's own body before setting the sail, and Lumi turns its back to a gust by itself.
ideas.toward: Lumi's own body (self) reading the same wind the yacht sails on; the island's wind field becoming one thing.
ideas.idea: Each crest feather is a short rod with drag from the local wind (the island's solved ground wind sampled at Lumi's head) plus gravity and stiffness; Lumi's heading responds to the pressure on its body when the gust exceeds a comfort force.
ideas.form: A change to Lumi's body plugin; a close traced film of Lumi on the dune in a gust, feathers streaming, squinting and turning.

ideas.title: Beach race: each friend rigs a board sail
ideas.goal: The friends each get a driftwood board with a scrap sail and race along the beach; each trims by its own temper (Pickles too tight and stalls, Truffle luffs and dawdles), and the player coaches one by moving its sheet.
ideas.toward: Friends using Lumi's machines (review: they never touch them), sails on the island.
ideas.idea: Every board's force comes from the solved sail flow (one box per board, smaller, or the same tables re-solved), friction from the sand law in wheelsand.jl; the friends' trim choices are a behaviour, the outcome is physics.
ideas.form: A mini game plugin on the beach; a film of the start, three sails filling, one stalling.

ideas.title: Tacking up the beach
ideas.goal: The wind blows down the beach; to get the cart back up, the player zig-zags, and each tack swings the boom across the deck (duck, Lumi!). Learning how close to the wind the yacht will point is the skill.
ideas.toward: The land yacht sailing anywhere, against the wind, by its flow.
ideas.idea: Apparent wind from true wind minus cart velocity; the sail's force from the solved flow at that angle; the cart's wheels give the lateral grip a keel gives a boat. The boom is a hinged rigid body that slams over by the wind's moment when the bow passes through the wind.
ideas.form: Controls in the yacht plugin; a top-down traced film of the zig-zag track in the wet sand.

ideas.title: The wind map in the sand
ideas.goal: Ripples, sand tails behind pebbles and dry spumes show the player where the wind is strong today on the beach, so they pick the run where the yacht goes fastest.
ideas.toward: The weather the cart runs on, read from the world instead of a gauge.
ideas.idea: Saltation flux from the solved ground wind writes ripples and lee tails into sandfield.jl over hours; strong wind patches get sharper ripples and moving streamers of particles.
ideas.form: A sand look change on the beach; a traced still at low sun where the ripples catch the light.

ideas.title: Capsize
ideas.goal: When the player oversheets in a strong gust, the yacht really goes over: mast in the sand, friends tumbling off, sail flogging. Then everyone heaves it back up together.
ideas.toward: Friends and cart as real bodies; the moment the big goal wants (the friends get off and push).
ideas.idea: Rigid-body cart with the sail's solved force at its centre of effort; when heel passes the tipping angle it falls by gravity; the friends are bodies that slide off; righting it is the friends pushing on the mast with their real masses.
ideas.form: Part of the yacht plugin; a film of the capsize and the heave.
